channel_identity.niche: History and geography quiz Shorts with a 5-second countdown: name the country, the year, the empire
channel_identity.positioning: Expedition-atlas aesthetic (paper, ink, one stamp-red), hand-drawn maps, mechanical clock. No AI imagery: every frame is code over open data.

production_policy.note: CLAUDE.md does not authorize automatic uploads for this channel yet: ask the user before publishing.

audio.note: attribution is mandatory in the description (attribution_*.txt)

metadata_rules.description_disclosure: Say it is a quiz made with code over open data; credit the music and the maps; ask viewers to comment their score
